description.value:
Prerequisite: Must be able to summon shikigami

You have specialized in shikigami and made it your life. Choose one type of shikigami you can summon to be your special. You have a number of Ability points equal to twice your proficiency bonus that you can use to increase the ability score of that shikigami (up to a max of 20). Additionally, you can command any of your shikigami as a free action on your turn. This does not let you command a shikigami multiple times per turn. If you have multiple shikigami, you can swap your special shikigami as part of a long rest.

system.requirements: Must be able to summon shikigami
